keyboardLayout.title: Keyboard Layout
keyboardLayout.desc: Select the keyboard layout of the remote operating system
tip: The virtual keyboard, text paste, and shortcut keys send individual keystrokes to the remote device.
The keyboard layout determines how these keystrokes are interpreted.
Make sure the selected layout matches the keyboard settings of the remote operating system.
Note: Text paste relies on direct keystroke input. Some non-Latin characters (such as Chinese, Japanese, or Korean) may not be supported due to input method limitations.

vlan.desc: Connect ArkKVM to tagged VLAN networks using IEEE 802.1Q.

enableWarning.title: Enable VLAN?
enableWarning.line1: Enabling VLAN mode replaces the untagged network interface with tagged VLAN interfaces.
enableWarning.line2: Incorrect settings may make the device unreachable.

primaryVlan.title: Primary VLAN
primaryVlan.desc: Used for outbound system traffic and internet-connected services.

vlanId.title: VLAN ID
vlanId.desc: Enter a VLAN ID between 1 and 4094. The connected switch port must allow this tagged VLAN.

secondaryVlan.title: Secondary VLAN
secondaryVlan.desc: Provides additional local access to ArkKVM, but does not carry outbound system traffic.
secondaryVlan.idDesc: Secondary VLAN must use a different VLAN ID from the Primary VLAN.

vlanDesc: Applying VLAN settings will temporarily interrupt the connection.
ArkKVM may obtain a new IP address. Reconnect using the updated address shown on the ArkKVM device screen.
If ArkKVM becomes unreachable because of incorrect VLAN settings, use Reset Network Config on the ArkKVM device screen to restore the default network settings.
Make sure your switch is configured for the selected VLAN(s) before applying these settings.

mcp.desc: Allow MCP-compatible agents to control ArkKVM.

forwarding.title: Network Service Forwarding
forwarding.desc: Allows MCP agents to connect to network services on the target computer, such as SSH and web APIs.
forwarding.warning: Enabling Network Service Forwarding disables Relative Mouse and Microphone Emulation.
confirmDescription: Network Service Forwarding allows AI agents to connect to network services on the target computer, such as SSH and web APIs, through ArkKVM.
This feature requires ArkKVM to emulate a USB network adapter (NIC). Due to USB device limits, enabling Network Service Forwarding will disable Relative Mouse and Microphone Emulation.
To use these features again, turn off Network Service Forwarding and re-enable them.

forwarding.unavailable: Unable to verify MCP and Network Service Forwarding settings. Reopen this page to try again.

netbird.setupKeyRecommended: Recommended for always-on devices: peers added with a setup key do not need to log in again.
netbird.desc: Connect ArkKVM to your NetBird network – NetBird Cloud or your own self-hosted management server
netbird.serverHint: Self-host the whole control plane to stay independent of third-party services

messages.ssoSessionExpiryHint: With SSO, NetBird ends the device's session after a while by default and it has to log in again – until then the KVM is unreachable over NetBird. Turn off "Session Expiration" in the settings of your NetBird dashboard, or join with a setup key below.
messages.loginExpiryWarning: This device joined via SSO and its session expires at the time shown – after that it is unreachable over NetBird until it logs in again. For an always-on KVM, turn off "Session Expiration" in the settings of your NetBird dashboard, or join with a setup key instead.

messages.tailscaleOverlap: Tailscale is enabled as well. Both use the 100.64.0.0/10 range by default – make sure your NetBird network range does not overlap with your tailnet.
